title: NEBCert: Automated Quality-Control, Transition State Verification, Nudged Elastic Band (NEB), Quantum Tunneling, and Reaction Kinetics Certification
description: An open-source scientific toolkit to audit NEB reaction pathways, verify transition states (1 imaginary frequency along reaction coordinate), compute Eyring-Polanyi TST rate constants k(T), and calculate Wigner and Eckart quantum tunneling corrections.
